verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Apify publishing its own official MCP server so external AI agents/LLMs can call Apify's Actors as tools (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3) — this is Apify acting as an MCP server, not as an MCP client consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence that a user can plug third-party MCP servers into Apify so its Actors/platform can use their tools.
